```{r}
# This is National parks official park boundaries
np <- read_sf(dsn = paste0(WKDir, "data_wol/tenure_npws_estateinternalboundaries/NPWS_EstateInternalBoundaries.shp"))
np_bmk <- subset(np, NAME %in% c("Blue Mountains National Park", "Kanangra-Boyd National Park")) # subset out Blue Mountains and Kanangra NP from other parks
np_bmk_bound <- st_make_valid(np_bmk) # fixing broken shapes
np_bmk <- st_union(np_bmk_bound) # tuning into one sf
np_bmk <- st_transform(np_bmk, 4326)
np_bmk_buff <- st_buffer(np_bmk, dist = 2000, nQuadSegs = 30) # changed from 500 to 2000
np_bmk_buff <- st_sfc(st_polygon(list(np_bmk_buff[[1]][[1]])), crs = st_crs(np_bmk_buff))
plot(np_bmk_buff)
```

```{r}
# This is tracks from open street maps
bmk <- read_sf(dsn = paste0(WKDir, "data_bmk/tracks/tracks_bmk_v3.shp"))
# plot(bmk$geometry)

bmk_tr <- st_intersection(bmk, np_bmk_buff)

bmk_tr <- bmk_tr[!bmk_tr$highway %in% c("proposed", "construction"), ]
bmk_tr$highway_com <- bmk_tr$highway

bmk_tr <- bmk_tr %>%
  mutate(highway_com = case_when(
    highway %in% c("trunk", "primary", "primary_link", "secondary", "secondary_link", "tertiary", "tertiary_link", "motorway", "motorway_link") ~ "Road",
    highway %in% c("residential", "unclassified", "service", "escape", "trunk_link", "pedestrian", "living_street", "cycleway", "busway", "corridor", "services") ~ "Access track",
    highway %in% c("track") ~ "Track",
    highway %in% c("footway", "steps", "path", "scramble") ~ "Path"
  ))
```

```{r}
# Getting occurrences records
occ_bmk_inat_all <- galah_call() |>
  galah_identify("Plantae") |>
  geolocate(bmk_bound) |>
  galah_filter(
    dataResourceName == "iNaturalist Australia",
    imageIDsCount >= 1
  ) |>
  galah_select(institutionID, informationWithheld, raw_informationWithheld, occurrenceID, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, group = "basic") |>
  atlas_occurrences()

occ_bmk_inat <- occ_bmk_inat_all %>% filter(is.na(raw_informationWithheld))

# turning occurrences records into shape file for compatibility
occ_bmk_sp <- galah_record_to_sf(occ_bmk_inat)
# filtering to match national park shapefile
occ_bmk <- st_filter(occ_bmk_sp, np_bmk)
```

```{r}
# This section just runs once. It takes the DEM and saves a slope rater than can be loaded in, in the next section.
# only run once, takes a long time and is memory intensive.
# 2 Metre Rasters
file = "D:/NSW Government - Spatial Services/DEM/2 Metre/"
filename = list.files(path=file, pattern = ".tif", full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

    one <- terra::rast(paste0(file, filename[1]))
    set_crs <- crs(one)

all_crs <- sapply(paste0(file,filename), function(f) crs(rast(f)))
unique_crs <- unique(all_crs) #two crs found MGA zone 55 and MGA zone 56

merged_groups <- list()
for (i in seq_along(unique_crs)) {
    target <- unique_crs[i]
    group_files <- paste0(file, filename)[all_crs == target]
    # Load tiles for group
    group_rasters <- lapply(group_files, rast)
    # Merge group
    merged_groups[[i]] <- do.call(mosaic, c(group_rasters, fun = mean))
}

LHS <- terra::project(merged_groups[[1]], crs(merged_groups[[2]]))
LHS <- resample(LHS, extend(merged_groups[[2]],LHS), method = "bilinear")
merged_2 <- mosaic(LHS, merged_groups[[2]], fun = mean)
```

```{r}
# 1 Metre Rasters
file <- "D:/NSW Government - Spatial Services/DEM/1 Metre/"
filename <- list.files(path = file, pattern = ".tif", full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

all_crs <- sapply(paste0(file,filename), function(f) crs(rast(f)))
unique_crs <- unique(all_crs)

merged_groups <- list()
for (i in seq_along(unique_crs)) {
    target <- unique_crs[i]
    group_files <- paste0(file, filename)[all_crs == target]
    # Load tiles for group
    group_rasters <- lapply(group_files, rast)
    # Merge group
    merged_groups[[i]] <- do.call(mosaic, c(group_rasters, fun = mean))
}
crs_corrected <- lapply(merged_groups, terra::project, y = set_crs)
resampled <- lapply(crs_corrected, terra::resample, y= crs_corrected[[1]], method = "bilinear")

merged_1 <- do.call(terra::mosaic, c(resampled, list(fun = mean)))
# merged_1 <- terra::project(merged_1, crs(merged_2))
ras_1 <- terra::aggregate(merged_1, fact = 2, fun = mean)
```

```{r}
# 5 Metre Rasters
file <- "D:/NSW Government - Spatial Services/DEM/5 Metre/"
filename <- list.files(path = file, pattern = ".tif", full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
rasters_5 <- lapply(filename, function(fn) terra::rast(paste0(file, fn)))
merged_5  <- do.call(mosaic, c(rasters_5, fun=mean))
ras_5_re <- resample(merged_5, rast(res = 2, crs = crs(merged_5), ext = ext(merged_5)), method = "bilinear")
ras_5 <- terra::project(ras_5_re, crs(merged_groups[[2]]))
```

```{r}
# Transferring via Toblers Hiking function
# f_exp <- function(x) {
#   ifelse(x > 70, NA, 1 / (6 * exp(-3.5 * abs(x / 100 + 0.05))))
# }
f_exp <- function(x) {
  speed <- 0.6 * (6 * exp(-3.5 * abs(x / 100 + 0.05)))  # km/h (off-track adjusted)
  ifelse(x > 70, NA, 1 / (speed * 1000))                # hours per metre
}
# cost surface in hours
cost_bmk <- app(slope_bmk_lake, f_exp,
  filename = paste0(WKDir, "data_bmk/cost.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
#crs(cost_bmk)

plot(cost_bmk)

```

```{r}
# Plotting slope

extract  <-ext_slope(occ_bmk_cost$geometry, slope_bmk)
extract <- subset(extract, select = -geometry)
occ_bmk_cost <- cbind(occ_bmk_cost, extract)

grid_bmk_comb <- grid_points_cost(n = nrow(occ_bmk_cost), np_outline = np_bmk_gda94, tr = tr_bmk, cost_surface = cost_surface_bmk)

grid_sf_slope <- ext_slope(grid_bmk_comb$geometry, slope_bmk)
grid_sf_slope <- subset(grid_sf_slope, select = -geometry)
grid_bmk_comb <-cbind(grid_bmk_comb , grid_sf_slope)

ggplot() +
geom_histogram(data=grid_bmk_comb, mapping=aes(x=slope), binwidth = 5,boundary = 0, position = "identity",fill="grey90", colour="grey90") +
geom_histogram(data=occ_bmk_cost, mapping= aes(x = slope, fill=source),binwidth = 5,boundary = 0, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE), alpha=0.5) + 
          scale_fill_manual(values=c("#BB0011","#5566AA"), name = "Source") +
            scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
          scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01))+
  labs(x="Slope (Degrees)", y= "Count")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = c(.98, .98),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey80"),
                legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.margin = margin(2,2,2,2))

ggsave(
       filename = paste0(WKDir,"output_bmk/plots/slope_bmk.png"),
       width = 7,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300
     )
```

```{r}
cost_plot <-  
    ggplot() +
    
    # cost surface 
    geom_spatraster(data = crop_cost_surface_bmk, maxcell=10000000,alpha=70,) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours=grDevices::hcl.colors(50, "YlOrBr", rev = TRUE), limits = c(0, 7), na.value = "white",name="Cost (Estimated hours)") +
    
    # Tracks background
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_background_bmk, aes(geometry=geometry), key_glyph = draw_key_path, col="grey85", lwd=0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = crop_osm_road_bmk, aes(geometry=geometry),col="grey70", key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    # Tracks
    geom_sf(data = crop_bmk_tr_gda94, aes(geometry=geometry, color = highway_com), key_glyph = draw_key_path, lwd=0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#88BBAA","#5566AA","#BB0011","#E69F00"), name ="Track Type") + 
    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
    
    # points
    geom_sf(data = crop_occ_bmk_cost_herb, aes(colour = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), size = as.factor(status.native_anywhere_in_aus), geometry = geometry), shape = 16, stroke = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = if (length(unique(crop_occ_bmk_cost_herb$status.native_anywhere_in_aus)) == 2) { c( "#666633","#99BB55") } else { c("#666633","#99BB55","orange")}, name = "Native Status" ) +
    scale_size_manual(values = if (length(unique(crop_occ_bmk_cost_herb$status.native_anywhere_in_aus)) == 2) { c(2, 2)} else { c(2, 2, 2)},name = "Native Status")+
    
    geom_text(data = crop_ml_bmk, aes(label = location, geometry = geometry), col="grey40", stat = "sf_coordinates", size = 3) +
    
    # plot design
    coord_sf() +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.key = element_rect(fill="grey90")) +
    scale_x_continuous( expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +

    labs(x = "", y="")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(WKDir,"output_bmk/plots/crop_cost_rast_bmk_herb.png"),
    width = 10,
    height = 15,
    dpi = 300)
```
